entities.summary: Israel is a sovereign nation in West Asia, Asia. Its capital is Jerusalem (declared; internationally disputed) / Tel Aviv (diplomatic). Official languages include Hebrew. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 9.9 million. Area: 22,072 km². historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a cradle of Judaism and a pivotal location in the biblical narrative, Israel has shaped Western civilization through its influence on Christianity and Islam. The country's modern history, marked by conflicts with neighboring nations and the establishment of the State of Israel in 1948, continues to have significant regional and global implications.
